image_description: A close-up, high-resolution portrait of a common iguana (Iguana iguana). The image focuses on the head and upper torso. The iguana has textured, granular scales in shades of greyish-green and brown, with darker banding visible on the neck and shoulder area. A prominent dorsal crest of spine-like scales runs along the back of the neck. The eye is large with a reddish-orange iris and round pupil. A large subtympanic shield is visible below the ear area. The background is softly blurred (bokeh), isolating the subject.
